dedupe_keys.name: supermarket refrigeration fault detection test data

description: This Figshare release records operating tests of a low-global-warming-potential supermarket refrigeration system under baseline and fault conditions. Its own item lists twelve files, including several baseline and fault-labelled CSV series and a small Python processing script. The Scientific Data descriptor describes faults such as an open display-case door, icing and expansion-valve failure. A modeller can test detection rules before using them in cold-chain or building-energy digital twins. The controlled test system and selected faults are a narrow benchmark, not a prevalence estimate for all supermarket equipment. Time-series variables and sensor calibration must be checked before transferring thresholds. Figshare states CC BY 4.0 for the item. I read the own file metadata and article notes without downloading CSV files or running diagnostics. The related metadata-only Figshare record is not a second dataset, and no catalogue match was found.
